tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /blo sbyongs don bdun ma'i bla ma brgyud pa'i

gsol 'debs bzhugs/ thub pa'i dbang po rgyal tshab byams pa dang*/ /thogs med sku mched grol sde rnam gnyis dang*/ /gu ṇa mi ṭa seng bzang gang ba spel/ /ku sa li pa che chung gser gling pa/ /a ti sha dang 'brom ston po to ba/ /spyi < sa > la < 'od zer gzhon nu > bu pa dang 'od zer < lha > bla ma dang*/ /lha < ram pa > sdings khu < byang chub 'bum > dbon gnyis dang yon tan dpal/ /bde ba dpal dang bka' bzhi grags gzhon dang*/ /bsod nams grags dang rgyal sras bzang po dpal/ / shākya bsod nams gzhon nu blo gros dang*/ /paṇa chen chos rje kun dga' mchog grub dang*/ /rje btsun grol mchog lung rig rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /blo sbyong brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs shing*/ /blos btang zlog sgom nus par byin gyis rlobs/ / rwa sgreng ba shāka bsod nams kyi don du/ dgra bcom yon tan blo gros bcug na yong zhes mkhan chen rin po che'i gsung/ yang na mang 'khar la tshul khrims dpal/ gzhon nu rgyal mchog /mus pa dkon rgyal/ rwa ston yon tan dpal bzang*/ kun dga' mchog grub pa byas kyang chog lags/ tā ra nā thas so// // - PAGE 100 -
